lessons.title: Cracks in the Black Box: Tolman & Chomsky
lessons.description: Trace the fall of radical behaviorism through Tolman's cognitive maps and Chomsky's devastating language critique.

lessons.title: Information Processing & The Computer Metaphor
lessons.description: Examine the 1950s cognitive turn, Broadbent's filter model, sensory registers, and computational architectures of mind.

lessons.title: Pioneering Cognitive Science: Miller & Neisser
lessons.description: Master George Miller's magical number seven, chunking mechanisms, and Ulric Neisser's defining 1967 textbook.

lessons.title: Neuropsychology & Memory Dissociation: Hebb & H.M.
lessons.description: Discover Donald Hebb's synaptic plasticity rule and Brenda Milner's landmark memory findings with Patient H.M.
